claims.disproof_condition: 條件：台光電、台燿或其他銅箔基板廠的重訊／年報寫出取消或延後已下單的設備、或同一批設備改向別家採購。核查頻率：每月（MOPS 重訊）＋每年（年報重要契約）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim，重讀含浸機／壓合機層讀圖的客戶資本承諾段。
claims.statement: Customer-side capital commitment (Elite Material material announcement, 2026-11-10): its Zhongshan subsidiary acquired operating machinery from Asia Metal Industries for NT$1,444,061 thousand (multiple transactions), board-approved on 2026-10-28; a second counterparty, Kunshan Ruiping precision coating equipment, reached NT$1,372,294 thousand within one year. The equipment type is not disclosed.
